name: The Baltimore Sun editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Baltimore Sun Center (low confidence, Oct. 2026) and Ad Fontes rates it Middle. Largest Maryland daily, bought in January 2024 by Sinclair executive chairman David Smith with Armstrong Williams; Williams said that month the Sun 'will stop endorsing political candidates' (Baltimore Banner, Jan. 20, 2024). Its opinion pages have run guest pieces against Question 3, but no board position was found, and no Sun editorial on Baltimore City Questions A to I was found (the site blocks automated reads). Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/baltimore-sun-media-bias.

name: The Baltimore Banner
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Baltimore Banner Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). As a 501(c)(3) newsroom it does not endorse candidates or ballot questions. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/baltimore-banner-media-bias.

name: The Washington Post editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Washington Post Editorial Board Lean Right (1.0, just past Center) after reviews in July and August 2026, with low confidence; it rates the Post's news pages Lean Left. In February 2025 owner Jeff Bezos refocused the opinion section on 'personal liberties and free markets.' Its editorial page (The Post's View) shows no endorsements in DC or Maryland races from Sept. 26 to Oct. 17, 2026, so it is treated as not endorsing this year. No policy statement on local endorsements was found. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/washington-post-editorial-board-media-bias.

name: League of Women Voters of Maryland (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters state chapter that describes the League as 'a nonpartisan organization' (https://www.lwvmd.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Maryland Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization; backs its nominees and campaigns for Question 3 (chair Steuart Pittman).

name: Maryland Republican Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization; backs its nominees. Runs the 'Save Our Voice' campaign to defeat Question 3.

name: Maryland State and DC AFL-CIO
lean_basis: State labor federation (AFL-CIO) that calls itself 'dedicated to represent the interests of working people at the state and local level' (https://mddclabor.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Maryland State Education Association
lean_basis: State teachers' union that calls itself 'a democratic, member-driven organization of school employees' (https://marylandeducators.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Maryland Chamber of Commerce
lean_basis: Statewide chamber of commerce that says it advocates 'for pro-business policies that drive economic growth' (https://www.mdchamber.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Maryland League of Conservation Voters
lean_basis: Environmental group that says 'We use political action and education to fight for clean water, healthy air, and a resilient climate for everyone in Maryland' (https://www.mdlcv.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Planned Parenthood Maryland Action Fund
lean_basis: Abortion-rights political arm of Planned Parenthood of Maryland. Planned Parenthood Action Fund says the federation works to 'defend reproductive rights' (https://www.plannedparenthoodaction.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Maryland Right to Life PAC
lean_basis: Anti-abortion group that says it 'defends the unalienable right to life for vulnerable human beings threatened by abortion' (https://www.mdrtl.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: NRA Political Victory Fund
lean_basis: Gun-rights PAC of the National Rifle Association, which calls itself 'a single issue organization' that grades candidates on 'Second Amendment issues' (https://www.nrapvf.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Maryland State Fraternal Order of Police
lean_basis: Maryland lodge of the Fraternal Order of Police; mdfop.org did not resolve on Oct. 17, 2026. The FOP's standard description, as posted by its Illinois lodge, says it is 'committed to improving the working conditions of law enforcement officers and the safety of those we serve' (https://www.ilfop.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
